command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = '40eac7a504d363a05cd6c235c25146e01bb36ff2'; test -n "$(adb shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r')"; echo '--- SCANNER_SERVICE ---'; adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -E 'ScannerService|foreground|startRequested|isForeground' || true; echo '--- NOTIFICATION ---'; adb shell dumpsys notification --noredact | grep -E 'io.blueeye|scanner_channel' | head -n 40 || true; echo '--- RECENT_SCANNER_LOGS ---'; adb logcat -d -v brief -s ScannerService:V BleScanner:V '*:S' | tail -n 120
